research_question: Can sealed parametric-memory disagreement identify when an entire retrieval environment has drifted far enough that uncorroborated RAG should no longer override answerable memory?
deployment_unit: A model-specific batch or time window of claims sharing one retrieval environment.

clean_reference.source: The 100 development clean RAG rows and their cached three-sample same-model internal outputs.
clean_reference.observation: One Bernoulli observation only when the internal majority is binary: whether RAG differs from that majority.
clean_reference.note: The clean reference includes every clean claim for the model; Fact2Fiction clean-correct filtering is not used to estimate it.

alarm.statistic: Beta-binomial posterior-predictive upper-tail probability under the model-specific clean disagreement rate.
alarm.multiple_model_policy: Each victim model raises its own alarm; no pooled model identity feature is used.

routing_ablation.normal_environment: Use low_rate_corroboration_candidate_v1: the per-row answerability fallback plus a typed leave-original-out corroboration override.
routing_ablation.drift_environment: Disable retrieval-based corroboration overrides and revert to the answerability fallback: binary memory majority, otherwise RAG.
routing_ablation.purpose: Test whether environment-level drift can select between the low-rate blend and its memory-first backbone. Full routing accuracy requires extending the frozen corroboration workflow to each evaluated rate.

evaluation.batch_semantics: Evaluate each condition/model cell as one exchangeable environment after the complete window is observed; no per-row online claim is made.
evaluation.cross_claim_transfer: Evaluate detection only, without method tuning, on the disjoint locked claims at clean and 1% for each attacker-victim cell. Attacker identity remains hidden from the alarm but is used for reporting. These locked claims were opened by earlier experiments, so this is a frozen cross-claim transfer diagnostic, not a new independent confirmation.
required_reporting: development routing accuracy against RAG, memory, and answerability
all retrospective-development and previously opened-test caveats

limitations_fixed_in_advance: The alarm requires a stream or batch sharing one retrieval environment and cannot protect the first claims immediately.
A sparse targeted attack may evade an aggregate drift alarm.
The response policy cannot repair internally unanswerable claims.
The selected low-rate corroboration method remains the primary per-claim candidate; this is a complementary environment-level study.
